title: Theo's Wobbly Snack Tower
markdown:
Dawn broke with a brilliant burst of gold and pink! Sunshine streamed into Theo’s room, tickling his nose. "Today’s picnic day!" he bounced out of bed. His heart thumped a fast, happy beat. Downstairs, Poppy the dormouse was already nibbling a tiny seed. Her whiskers twitched with delight. Ms. Vale, their kind neighbour, hummed a cheerful tune. She was helping prepare the picnic.

"Look, Theo, my clever chap!" Ms. Vale called. She pointed to a colourful tower of snack boxes. "I've stacked them high for our fantastic feast!"

Theo dashed over. The boxes were piled up, bursting with delicious treats! Big boxes held crunchy crackers. Medium boxes packed juicy apple slices. Tiny boxes topped the stack with mini-muffins. But as Theo nudged the bottom box, a wobble started. Gulp! The whole tower swayed! It tipped this way, then that way! Thump! The snacks tumbled everywhere.

"Oh dear me!" squeaked Poppy. She dove behind a floral cushion.

Theo’s brow furrowed. He tried again. Big box, then medium, then small. Wobble! Crash! He shook his head. He tried a different order. Tilt! Splat! The snack tower wouldn’t stay up. Theo slumped his shoulders. "This is trickier than building a rocket!" he puffed.

Poppy peeked out. Her bright eyes looked thoughtful. "Maybe," she whispered, "we should look for clues outside." She scurried out the door and darted under a bushy lavender plant. It smelled wonderfully sweet! There, she saw a perfectly round, grey pebble balanced on its side. It sat still. Then, Poppy spotted a larger, flatter stone next to it. Theo joined her. "Look, Poppy! See how that big, flat stone is right at the bottom? It makes a super stable base! It’s not wobbly at all!"

He picked up a flat stone. He carefully placed another, smaller stone right on top. It stayed put! He grinned. He tried placing a tiny pebble on top of the big stone. Perfectly balanced! He bounced on the balls of his feet.

"I get it!" Theo shouted, his eyes sparkling. "It’s all about balance! We need the biggest, heaviest things at the bottom to hold everything up! That way, it doesn’t tumble down!"

Back inside, Theo and Poppy, a dynamic duo, set to work. They took the biggest, heaviest snack box – the crackers – and placed it firmly in the centre of the table. Then, with great care, they placed the next biggest box, the apple slices, right on top. They made sure it was perfectly centred. Finally, they delicately put the smallest boxes of muffins on the very top.

They held their breath, their eyes wide. It… stayed! The tower stood tall, a perfect, steady snack mountain. Not a single wobble!

"Hooray!" cheered Ms. Vale, clapping her hands. "It’s a super-stable snack tower! You did it!"

Theo beamed, his chest puffing out. "It's all about balance!" he explained. "When we put the heaviest things at the bottom, and the lighter things on top, they don’t tip over! It keeps everything steady!"

Poppy, happily munching a tiny piece of muffin, squeaked with joy. "It’s like magic, but it’s really science!" she declared.

Ms. Vale smiled. "You two are brilliant builders, and brilliant discoverers too!"

Theo grabbed a cracker box, his excitement bubbling. "This picnic is going to be absolutely fantastic!" he declared. And with a wide, happy grin, Theo, Poppy, and Ms. Vale grabbed their plates, ready to feast on their perfectly balanced bounty. The adventure was just beginning…
characters: Theo the bridge builder, Poppy the dormouse, Ms. Vale
